blocks.text: Of the many different kinds of drugs distributed and used illegally in Canada, marijuana happens to be one of the most popular. In many cases, cannabis or marijuana is commonly used for recreational purposes and it has been found out that ten percent of marijuana users have the risk of developing marijuana addiction. While cannabis is not very addictive, a person who makes use of it in an abusive manner finds it hard to quit it. Someone who is addicted to this drug simply loves his lifestyle so his addiction is quite strong and persistent. Marijuana has the following street names on which they also known for: Blow, Ganja, Hash, Dope, Grass and Draw.

raw_html:
Marijuana Addiction

What is Marijuana Addiction?

Marijuana: When someone abuses marijuana and craves for it to keep himself going then this is called marijuana addiction. In other words, a person is not capable functioning normally without a dose of cannabis.

Of the many different kinds of drugs distributed and used illegally in Canada, marijuana happens to be one of the most popular. In many cases, cannabis or marijuana is commonly used for recreational purposes and it has been found out that ten percent of marijuana users have the risk of developing marijuana addiction. While cannabis is not very addictive, a person who makes use of it in an abusive manner finds it hard to quit it. Someone who is addicted to this drug simply loves his lifestyle so his addiction is quite strong and persistent. Marijuana has the following street names on which they also known for: Blow, Ganja, Hash, Dope, Grass and Draw.

Find A Drug Rehab

The Effects of Marijuana

When taken in small doses, marijuana offers a stimulating and relaxing sensation. In many cases, the system of users is enhanced and so with their appetite. However, if cannabis is taken in larger quantities, or when it is taken with stronger strains, the effects that will be experienced are similar to the effects of mushrooms and LSD. Users are also known to experience mild hallucinations, nausea, paranoia and anxiety. Taking this drug also increases heart rate, dryness of the mouth and reddening of the eyes. Other possible effects also include perceptual distortions, increased appreciation of sensory experiences, disassociation and elevation of mood.

Find A Drug Rehab

Who Uses Marijuana?

Marijuana or cannabis has been very popular and widely used app over the world for a long, long time now. In Canada, cannabis is frequently used as an illicit drug and almost half of the Canadian population has admitted that they used marijuana at least once in their lifetime. On the other hand, many people in the country have also admitted that they make use of marijuana regularly and obviously, this can be an indication of marijuana addiction.

Cannabis use is simply widespread in the country and it is alarming to note that children as young as 12 years old take part in the illicit use of this drug. On account to this, the Canadian government is simply posed to curbing this problem as it so happens that many crimes, accidents and other untoward incidents are attributed to marijuana use and addiction.
